title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The page incorrectly labels Facilitator app automation as undocumented, despite identifying its documented cmdlet. Its categorical claim that there is no single tenant switch is also unsupported; the sources describe tenant-wide prerequisite controls. The rollout, licensing and listed configuration paths are supported.
